==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a VR gaming convention. A leprechaun greets me as I enter. I feel some of his luck magic rub off on me.

I meet a group of young developers. They are struggling to come up with a fresh game concept. I ask if I can become a member of the team.

The developers offer me a position as story writer. Just as I am getting ready to start writing, one member of the team tries to assert that I am not familiar with enough cyber stories to qualify. I prove myself by listing a number of my favorite cyber stories involving virtual worlds.
